meta.title: 6 cognitive biases fooling you every single day

beats.text: Six cognitive biases quietly running your life right now.
One. Confirmation bias — you only notice the evidence that proves you were already right.
Two. The sunk cost trap — you keep going simply because you've already paid so much.
Three. Availability — you fear the dramatic and rare, and ignore the boring and likely.
Four. Dunning–Kruger — the less you understand, the more certain you tend to feel.
Five. Negativity bias — one harsh comment can outweigh ten kind ones.
Six. Hindsight — once you know how it ended, you swear you saw it coming all along.
You can't delete them. But naming a bias is the first step to stealing its power.
